fullPassage: We all negotiate every day, whether we realise it or not. Yet few people ever learn how to negotiate. Those who do usually learn the traditional, win-lose negotiating style rather than an approach that is likely to result in a win-win agreement. This old-school, adversarial approach may be useful in a one-off negotiation where you will probably not deal with that person again. However, such transactions are becoming increasingly rare, because most of us deal with the same people repeatedly — our spouses and children, our friends and colleagues, our customers and clients. In view of this, it's essential to achieve successful results for ourselves and maintain a healthy relationship with our negotiating partners at the same time. In today's interdependent world of business partnerships and long-term relationships, a win-win outcome is fast becoming the only acceptable result.

questions.passage: We all negotiate every day, whether we realise it or not. Yet few people ever learn how to negotiate. Those who do usually learn the traditional, win-lose negotiating style rather than an approach that is likely to result in a win-win agreement. This old-school, adversarial approach may be useful in a one-off negotiation where you will probably not deal with that person again. However, such transactions are becoming increasingly rare, because most of us deal with the same people repeatedly — our spouses and children, our friends and colleagues, our customers and clients. In view of this, it's essential to achieve successful results for ourselves and maintain a healthy relationship with our negotiating partners at the same time. In today's interdependent world of business partnerships and long-term relationships, a win-win outcome is fast becoming the only acceptable result.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 글은 반복적 관계가 일반화된 상호 의존적 세계에서 win-win이 유일하게 받아들일 만한 결과가 되어간다고 결론지음 — 요지 일치
❌ ② 대립적(win-lose) 태도는 글이 지양하는 낡은 방식
❌ ③ 협상을 배울 필요 없다는 내용은 글에 없음(오히려 배우는 사람이 드물다고 지적)
❌ ④ 일회성 거래는 점점 드물어진다고 했으므로 반대
det.tip: 결론: win-win = the only acceptable result.

ch: 상호 의존적인 오늘날 세계에서는 서로에게 이득이 되는 승-승 협상이 점점 유일하게 바람직한 방식이 되고 있다.
협상에서 이기려면 상대를 압도하는 대립적 태도를 길러야 한다.
협상은 타고나는 재능이므로 굳이 배우려 애쓸 필요가 없다.
일회성 거래를 늘려 더 많은 사람과 만나는 것이 협상의 핵심이다.
